plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("charm pricing" OR "left-digit effect" OR ".99 pricing" OR "psychological pricing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR pricing OR commerce OR "online retail" OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Catches empirical studies on the psychological impact of specific price endings and the left-digit effect.

queries.query: ("discount framing" OR "percent discount" OR "absolute discount" OR "discount depth") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR pricing OR "promotion effectiveness")
queries.rationale: Targets research on how different discount presentations affect perceived value, brand quality, and purchase intent.

queries.query: ("ad creative" OR "advertisement effectiveness" OR "advertising copy" OR "visual advertising") AND (conversion OR "click-through rate" OR "purchase intent" OR "ad performance")
queries.rationale: Finds studies measuring the impact of specific ad elements (text, visuals, format) on conversion metrics.

queries.query: ("product naming" OR "brand name" OR "product name" OR "name fluency") AND (marketing OR consumer OR "brand perception" OR "purchase likelihood")
queries.rationale: Retrieves evidence on how name characteristics (e.g., fluency, meaning, sound) influence consumer evaluation and choice.

queries.query: ("scarcity cue" OR "limited availability" OR "limited quantity" OR "scarcity messaging") AND (marketing OR consumer OR "purchase behavior" OR "urgency" OR checkout)
queries.rationale: Captures experimental results on how scarcity signals (limited-time, limited-stock) affect conversion and checkout completion.

queries.query: ("nudge" OR "default option" OR "choice architecture" OR "social proof") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR "online retail" OR "conversion optimization")
queries.rationale: Targets applied research on specific nudges (defaults, social proof, simplification) that increase conversion in online settings.

queries.query: ("landing page" OR "website design" OR "webpage optimization") AND (conversion OR "user experience" OR "A/B testing" OR "click-through")
queries.rationale: Finds empirical studies testing elements of landing page design (layout, content, CTAs) against conversion outcomes.

queries.query: ("price elasticity" OR "price sensitivity" OR "price response") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR "demand analysis")
queries.rationale: Captures research quantifying how demand changes with price, relevant for pricing and discount strategy.

queries.query: ("review valence" OR "review helpfulness" OR "online review" OR "customer review") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR "purchase decision")
queries.rationale: Targets studies on how review characteristics (star rating, text content, helpfulness votes) influence sales.

queries.query: ("promotion campaign" OR "sales promotion" OR "promotional incentive") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR "campaign effectiveness")
queries.rationale: Finds research evaluating the performance of different promotional tactics (coupons, bundles, giveaways).

queries.query: ("message framing" OR "gain-loss framing" OR "attribute framing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR "persuasion")
queries.rationale: Captures experiments on how framing a message (e.g., gain vs. loss, attribute focus) affects consumer response.

queries.query: ("visual complexity" OR "information density" OR "simplicity") AND (marketing OR consumer OR "ad effectiveness" OR "website design")
queries.rationale: Targets studies measuring how visual or informational complexity in ads or websites impacts engagement and conversion.

queries.query: ("free shipping" OR "shipping cost" OR "delivery fee") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR "purchase decision")
queries.rationale: Finds research on the impact of shipping costs and free shipping offers on conversion and cart abandonment.

queries.query: ("A/B testing" OR "experimental design" OR "field experiment") AND (marketing OR consumer OR "campaign optimization" OR "website optimization")
queries.rationale: Captures papers on the application and results of experimental methods (A/B tests, field experiments) in marketing optimization.
Recall-safety query: broad net for any marketing research focused on concrete performance outcomes.

queries.query: ("consumer" OR "customer") AND (conversion OR "purchase behavior" OR "decision making")
queries.rationale: Recall-safety query: broad net for consumer behavior research directly tied to purchase or conversion actions.

plan.coverage_notes: Plan focuses on empirical, conversion-oriented aspects of marketing science relevant to a growth marketer: pricing, discounts, ads, naming, scarcity, nudges, landing pages, reviews, promotions, framing, and testing methods. Deliberately skips brand theory, advertising history, media studies, and macroeconomic models. Assumes the reader wants actionable findings with measurable outcomes, not theoretical frameworks.
